<span style="color: #333333; font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular; font-size: x-large;"><span lang="zh-CN"><b>空城计</b></span></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">

<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="font-size: x-large;"><i style="color: #333333;">The Empty City Stratagem</i></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
A well known example is a fictional incident from the novel 'Romance
of the Three Kingdoms' (<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">三国演义</span></span>),
attributed to Luo Guanzhong (<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">罗贯中</span></span>,
1330-1400 A.D.), which romanticizes events in the Three Kingdoms
Period. There it is written that, in 228 A.D., when Zhuge Liang of
Shu was attacking Wei, the Wei general Sima Yi (<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">司马懿</span></span>,
179-251 A.D.) created a distraction by capturing the small Shu town
of Jieting. This alarmed Zhuge Liang, and so he sent troops to help,
and kept only 2,500 in his capital, Xicheng. Sima Yi then left
Jieting and moved into Xicheng with 150,000 troops, determined to
sack his rival. On seeing the vast columns of dust of the approaching
troops, Zhuge Liang took down all of the Shu banners, opened all the
city gates, and had his soldiers dress as commoners to hang around
sweeping floors as the Wei troops approached. Zhuge Liang was
supposedly sitting on the ramparts of the high tower playing his lute
when Sima Yi first laid eyes on the city. Believing this was a trap,
Sima Yi fled [15].</span></span></p>

<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, serif; font-size: large;"><i><span style="font-weight: normal;">The
Empty City Stratagem</span></i></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
is associated with the 39th hexagram, </span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><i>Water
over Mountain</i></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">.
Water signifies a danger that lies ahead, while the Mountain
signifies an obstruction from behind, making futile any attempt at
retreat. To persevere in this situation one must turn inward and wait
in the stillness of the Mountain. The yang line in the third position
cannot content with that in the fifth, stronger position It pauses,
conceals the weaker yin lines within, and creates an illusion of
strength </span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">[1], [28]</span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">.</span></p>

<div dir="ltr" id="Section84" style="column-count: 2;"><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	1) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我比你离他近。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	2) Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">你怎么来晚了？</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333; text-decoration: none;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</span><span style="color: #333333; text-decoration: none;">A:
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">我上电梯的时候，按错了按钮。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<div class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-align: left; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	3) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我听说不应该喝草莓味的牛奶，除非是天</span></span>
    <span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;然的。</span></span></span></span></div>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: medium;">Trans.: I’ve heard that one
	shouldn’t drink strawberry milk unless it is natural.</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333; text-decoration: none;">
    4)</span><span style="color: #0047AB !important;">《三国演义》是一本很好的书，它的作者</span></span>
    <span style="color: #0047AB !important;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;是罗贯中。</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	5) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我来中国之前没玩过象棋，只玩过国际象</span></span>
    <span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;棋。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: medium;">Trans.: Before I came to
	China I never played Chinese chess, I only played (international)
	chess.</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	6) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">在这里看不到星星。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	7) I. <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我没有那么多时间在这里等你。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333; text-decoration: none;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</span><span style="color: #333333; text-decoration: none;">II.
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">不需要太长时间。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	8) Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">你说的玉米片是什么样子的？</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333; text-decoration: none;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</span><span style="color: #333333; text-decoration: none;">A:
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">墨西哥玉米片，是这个样子的。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	9) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">圣诞节，大家互相说“圣诞快乐”，送礼</span></span>
    <span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;物。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	10)  <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">那个自助餐有各种各样好吃的。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<div class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-align: left; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	11) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">有的时候，父母为了惩罚小孩子，会让</span></span>
    <span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;他们去房间里。有的时候，政府为了惩</span></span>
    <span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;罚坏人，会让他们去监狱里。</span></span></span></span></div>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<div class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-align: left; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	12) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">医生告诉我，不应该吃坚果，而且特别</span></span>
    <span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;不应该吃花生。</span></span></span></span></div>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><a name="tw-target-text14"></a></span></span>
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333; text-decoration: none;">
    13)
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">那个</span></span></span><span lang="zh-CN">棋</span><span style="text-decoration: none;"><span lang="zh-CN">手还没有被打败。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	14) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">没有棋子的时候，我们用硬币当象棋。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<div class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-align: left; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	15) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">他骑摩托车的时候摔倒了，但是他至少</span></span>
    <span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;戴头盔了。</span></span></span></span></div>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	16) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">他不是故意弄丢你的简历的。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span face="Noto Sans CJK SC Black, sans-serif" style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif;"><span lang="en-US">
    17)
	</span></span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular; font-size: large;"><span lang="zh-CN">她刚刚开始了一个新的项目。</span></span></p>
</div>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333;">
-------------------------------------</span></p>

</p>

<p><style type="text/css">p { margin-bottom: 0.1in; direction: ltr; color: #000000; line-height: 120%; orphans: 2; widows: 2; background: transparent }p.western { font-family: "Liberation Serif", "Times New Roman", serif; font-size: 12pt; so-language: en-US }p.cjk { font-family: "Noto Sans CJK SC Regular"; font-size: 12pt; so-language: zh-CN }p.ctl { font-family: "FreeSans"; font-size: 12pt; so-language: hi-IN }a:link { color: #000080; so-language: zxx; text-decoration: underline }</style></p>
